title: Rabelais in Lyon
show: History of Philosophy Without Any Gaps

description: Philosopher Peter Adamson on François Rabelais, whose comic giants Gargantua and Pantagruel mocked the learning of his day. Rabelais was a doctor at Lyon’s Hôtel-Dieu in 1532, the year Pantagruel was printed in the city.
